blocks.heading: AI Integrations that *Work for Your Business*
blocks.lead: We embed intelligent AI directly into your products and workflows — from GPT-powered chatbots that qualify leads 24/7 to document analysis, smart reporting, and custom LLM workflows.

header.title: Real AI, *not gimmicks*
header.subtitle: Production-grade AI that solves real business problems — deployed, monitored, and maintained by us.

items.title: AI Chatbots
items.body: GPT-powered assistants that qualify leads, answer product questions, book appointments, and escalate to humans — all without manual effort.

items.title: Document AI
items.body: Extract, classify, and summarise invoices, contracts, reports, and forms automatically — cutting document processing time by 80%+.

items.title: Intelligent Search
items.body: Semantic search across your knowledge base, product catalogue, or documentation so users find exactly what they need, instantly.

items.title: Smart Reporting
items.body: AI-generated insights, anomaly detection, and plain-English summaries of complex data delivered to your team automatically.

items.title: Lead Scoring
items.body: AI models that rank, prioritise, and route leads based on behaviour, profile, and historical conversion data — so sales focuses on winners.

items.title: Custom LLM Workflows
items.body: Fine-tuned models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines for use cases unique to your industry and data.

header.title: AI built for *production*
header.subtitle: We don't just prompt ChatGPT — we build AI systems that hold up in the real world.

items.title: Use Case Discovery
items.body: We identify the highest-ROI AI opportunities in your business — where AI will save the most time or generate the most revenue.

items.title: Model Selection
items.body: We select the right models and architectures — GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, or open-source — based on your cost, latency, and quality requirements.

items.title: Integration & Build
items.body: We connect AI to your existing systems — CRM, website, support tools — through APIs, webhooks, and custom middleware.

items.title: Evaluate & Refine
items.body: Ongoing quality monitoring, prompt tuning, and model updates to ensure the AI keeps performing as your data and needs evolve.

items.title: Web Development
items.body: Embed AI directly into your product
